Method: rank-then-regress (target, group indicator and covariates ranked; covariate ranks regressed out by OLS with an intercept; Pearson correlation of the residuals)
P_Value: t distribution, n - 2 - k degrees of freedom
Alternative_Not_Used: regress-then-rank (OLS residuals of raw values, then Spearman), used in version 2.0.1
Note: with a two-valued group indicator, regress-then-rank orders subjects within each group by the covariate and shrinks the estimate even for a noise covariate; rank-then-regress does not, and its unadjusted value is Spearman's rho
